requirements.quote:
BGP does not use any TCP-based, keep-alive mechanism to determine if
   peers are reachable.
requirements.condition: determining whether BGP peers are reachable
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a TCP-based keep-alive mechanism to determine BGP peer reachability.
requirements.why_checkable: Peer reachability logic can be checked for reliance on TCP keep-alive.

requirements.quote:
Instead, KEEPALIVE messages are exchanged
   between peers often enough not to cause the Hold Timer to expire.
requirements.condition: maintaining a BGP session with an active Hold Timer
requirements.required_behavior: Exchange KEEPALIVE messages often enough to prevent Hold Timer expiration due to insufficient KEEPALIVE frequency.
requirements.why_checkable: KEEPALIVE scheduling can be compared against the active Hold Timer interval.

requirements.quote:
A
   reasonable maximum time between KEEPALIVE messages would be one third
   of the Hold Time interval.
requirements.condition: choosing a KEEPALIVE interval for a nonzero Hold Time
requirements.required_behavior: Use one third of the Hold Time interval as the suggested maximum time between KEEPALIVE messages; this is advisory.
requirements.why_checkable: The suggested scheduling bound is a concrete ratio that can be compared with configured or observed intervals.

requirements.quote:
KEEPALIVE messages MUST NOT be sent more
   frequently than one per second.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Send KEEPALIVE messages more frequently than one per second.
requirements.why_checkable: Successive KEEPALIVE transmission timestamps can be checked against the one-second minimum spacing.

requirements.quote:
An implementation MAY adjust the
   rate at which it sends KEEPALIVE messages as a function of the Hold
   Time interval.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY adjust the KEEPALIVE transmission rate as a function of the Hold Time interval; adjustment is permitted, not required.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer configuration can reveal whether the permitted Hold-Time-dependent scheduling is implemented.

requirements.quote:
If the negotiated Hold Time interval is zero, then periodic KEEPALIVE
   messages MUST NOT be sent.
requirements.condition: the negotiated Hold Time interval is zero
requirements.why_checkable: A session negotiated with zero Hold Time can be observed for periodic KEEPALIVE transmission.

requirements.quote:
A KEEPALIVE message consists of only the message header and has a
   length of 19 octets.
requirements.condition: encoding or accepting a KEEPALIVE message
requirements.required_behavior: The KEEPALIVE message contains only the message header.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include a body or other content after the header in a KEEPALIVE message.
requirements.why_checkable: KEEPALIVE encoding and parsing can be checked for header-only structure.

requirements.quote:
A KEEPALIVE message consists of only the message header and has a
   length of 19 octets.
requirements.condition: encoding or accepting a KEEPALIVE message
requirements.required_behavior: The KEEPALIVE message length is exactly 19 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded message size and accepted Length field can be checked against 19 octets.
